content: For patients whose A1C levels are 1.5% or more above their individualized target, it is often necessary to implement combination therapy to achieve optimal glycemic control. This therapeutic approach typically involves the use of agents with high efficacy, such as GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists (GIP/GLP-1 RAs), and sodium-glucose co-transporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors. These pharmacological agents, when used in combination, not only improve glycemic regulation but also provide additional benefits for cardiovascular health, offering a more comprehensive approach to diabetes management.
